use default

in_order[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) -> bool =>
    (0..values.count - 1)
        |> all(i => values[i] <= values[i + 1])

next_permutation[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    let pivot mut = values.count - 2

    while pivot >= 0 /\ values[pivot] >= values[pivot + 1] do
        pivot = pivot - 1
    od

    if pivot >= 0 then
        let successor mut = values.count - 1

        while values[successor] <= values[pivot] do
            successor = successor - 1
        od

        (values[pivot], values[successor]) = (values[successor], values[pivot])
    fi

    let low mut = pivot + 1
    let high mut = values.count - 1

    while low < high do
        let temp = values[low]

        values[low] = values[high]
        values[high] = temp

        low = low + 1
        high = high - 1
    od
si

permutation_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    while !in_order(values) do
        next_permutation(values)
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([3, 5, 1, 4, 2])

permutation_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))
